conversations.answer: Given the structure of the App.jsx file, it can be split into several components to help manage its growth. These components can be identified as follows:PromptDescriptorViewer: This component is already separated.NotesInput: This component will contain the text input for the notes.StartButton: This component will contain the start button and its event handling logic.PromptDisplay: This component will display the generated prompt.TasksList: This component will display the tasks in a select dropdown.Here is the shell script to create these components.[CODE_BLOCK_0]This script creates new files for each component in a newly created components directory under frontend. It then updates the App.jsx file to use these new components. The state and necessary props are passed to these components from the App component, keeping the state centralized in the App component. This structure should be easier to maintain and expand upon in the future.
